interpretations.headline: Try the route your learners will take
interpretations.summary: This result records the statement that best matched your current practice. Pick one small action to try and use what you notice to decide what comes next.

guidance.text: Open a resource on a device learners use. Check keyboard navigation, captions, and whether key instructions are available in more than one form.

interpretations.summary: This result records the statement that best matched your current practice. Pick one small action to try and use what you notice to decide what comes next.

guidance.text: Give two ways to practise or show the same learning goal. Ask what helped and what made either route harder.

interpretations.summary: This result records the statement that best matched your current practice. Pick one small action to try and use what you notice to decide what comes next.

guidance.text: Let students choose a question, example, or presentation format, then look at their reasons and the work they produce.

guidance.text: Use a short before-class task whose responses become the first discussion. Make that step clear to students who missed the task.

limitations: Each result describes your selected practice for one competence. The original choices are shown as A1 through C2 (1–6); not yet aware is a valid response (0).
